anchor.instructionPriority: User's explicit blue-sky mid-afternoon description and Denver balance take precedence over contradictory file numbering

sky.interpolation: Linear RGB; elevation above world horizon, not screen height
sky.cloudPolicy: One clear partly cloudy preset; projected clouds differ with camera direction, not per-view color grades

sun.fixturePolicy: One illustrative art-review fixture in world coordinates. No timestamp/location or camera headings have been validated from images. Production live/recap solar model overrides fixture elevation/azimuth; never falsify real weather/time to enforce hero lighting.
sun.fillCalibration: On the same neutral diagnostic plane, normalized lit contributions are direct=.38 and diffuse fill=.62, giving shadow/lit=.62 before AO. These are contribution ratios, not renderer-specific environment intensity units. Calibrate against E0; directIntensityRelativeClearE0=1 retains the clear-state sun scale.

shadows.tintRole: Cool-neutral gray-blue appearance cue, not a purple overlay on every surface or a replacement albedo
shadows.softEdgePolicy: Existing filtered directional shadows with moderate penumbra; preserve dark geometric recesses. No additional shadow map/light/pass.
shadows.occlusionMerge: min(existingVisibility,newVisibility); don't multiply repeated contact AO

exposure.reference: Frozen clear-day E0 from existing paintover-v1 ordinary-street, not absolute camera EV/lux
exposure.toneMapPolicy: Use one renderer tone mapper/white balance across views. Warm sun is lighting; no extra yellow/sepia post-grade.

ground.colorRole: Dry neutral reference/base swatches, not fixed lit/shadow pixels

trees.positionPolicy: Keep existing trunk bases and approximate crown envelopes

dressing.placement: Illustrative inferred curbside dressing; road-side of curb only, clear sidewalks and drive accesses
dressing.lamps: A few generic unlit posts in parkway; no extra daytime lights
dressing.treePits: Small earth/mulch pits at existing parkway trunks only; not authorization to move trees or pave lawns

compatibility.conflict: Per-frame grades vary: ordinary +.35 EV vs Lakeview +.20 EV and golden palettes. New shared hero block supersedes those per-frame day grades for these four references only.
compatibility.resolution: Use ordinary +.35 EV/1.06 contrast/1.08 saturation once; remove old warmth grade (4%) because warm light tint now supplies warmth. Preserve houseTypes values.

compatibility.conflict: Ordinary 15:30 uses +.10 EV and #99AFE0 fill. Hero uses +.35 EV referenced to paintover-v1 E0 and neutralized #AEBCCA fill; no renderer equivalence proven. The old 2.2 key:fill witness ratio also conflicts with a .62 shadow/lit witness ratio if both mean contributions on the same plane.
compatibility.resolution: This is an explicitly versioned hero review preset, not a silent rewrite of time-of-day keys. Calibrate E0 and witness patch before adopting in engine. For the shared hero witness use direct .38 / fill .62, hence key:fill .612903. Do not also apply the legacy 2.2 contribution ratio.

compatibility.conflict: Hero dry ground/wetness=0 is inapplicable to rain. Rain's per-surface darkening and roughness changes must not be stacked with another wetness policy.
compatibility.resolution: Keep dry palette as base. When rain active, rain-v1 materialFormula overrides dry roughness; apply its single darkening multiplier (max12%) once, then weather-state light/sky override hero clear sun.

compatibility.conflict: Hero directSun=1/blue sky/+.35 EV cannot coexist with blue-hour directSun=0/+ .20EV, night directSun=0/+ .35EV or morning-fog reduced direct sun/optical depth.
compatibility.resolution: Hero is one clear daytime state only. At night/blue-hour/fog use named state lighting, exposure and atmosphere as replacements, not summed EV or hero sun beneath fog/night. House geometry/base palette remains shared.

compatibility.conflict: Earlier validation said source lighting direction remained close. This revision intentionally changes lighting, ground color balance and postcard vegetation/dressing.
compatibility.resolution: Supersede earlier validation for new hero files; originals remain intact. Generated shadow bearings and exact hex pixels are illustrative, not measured.

fogReference.VMeaning: Distance at which an ideal high-contrast object retains5% of its original contrast in this authored homogeneous model. Not a meteorological definition, fog end, guaranteed human seeing distance, or device depth precision.
fogReference.ordering: Surface lighting/contact/wetness -> one fog application in linear light -> shared exposure/grade/tone map. Apply no independent distance saturation/contrast fade or blur.
fogReference.liveVisibility: When valid weather visibility exists, use it as V. For V<=5m set nearClearM=min(5,0.1V) and sigma=ln(20)/max(0.01,V-nearClearM); valid visibility must be positive. Preserve raw observation separately; do not clamp densefog to60m. Reporting-limited high values remain lower bounds. Missing visibility plus explicitfog may use authoredmoderate220m fallback flaggedassumed; morning alone never selectsfog.
fogReference.infiniteRay: Sky uses path through supplied layer to exit, not infinite distance blindly; cap optical depth at12 before exponent.
fogReference.weatherCompatibility: Proposes replacing the weather-v1 stylized25/220 street and100/600 aerial fog start/end pair with one extinction policy. Do not multiply or apply both. Changes near-clear band to5m from legacy10m floor. Legacy adapter may keep existing fallback but cannot claim exact exponential parity.
fogReference.modeConsistency: Same environmental sigma/colour/layer across modes. Aerial rays above/shallowly through layer differ by physical path length, never arbitrary camera-specific larger visibility.

transition.method: smoothstep from frozen displayed endpoints; blend optical depth/sigma and linear colours once; retarget from current state

layers.baseReference: supplied ground/lake surface elevation; all demo heights assumptions
layers.profile: w(h)=1 for0<=h<=H-taper; linear decrease to0 across upper taper;0 aboveH. Belowground ignored. tau=sigma*integral w(h(s))ds over ray from nearClearM onward; T=exp(-tau). Linear height along ray allows exact piecewise polynomial integration, no raymarch. Scene horizontal domain supplied; clip layer to domain, not camera.
layers.domain: Baseline broad horizontal layer for flat testregion. Maximumone layer/domain; use existing loaded extent with boundaries beyondview, no hard visible box. Local lake-only density requires supplied domain and smooth boundary extinction; if unavailable use uniformlayer and flag it. Do not infer local densefog from OSMwater alone.
layers.skyAndWater: Use same integrated extinction for terrain/water/buildings/sky-to-layerexit. Aerial roofs/crowns abovetop are not whitened by opaque fog sheet. Water can receive stronger apparentveil through long shallow rays, not independent whiteoverlay.
layers.terrainLimitation: A single horizontal analytic layer is appropriate only to flat supplied testregions. Hilly terrain needs validated regional layers or uniformdistance fallback; no per-fragment terrain-following density solve required.

weatherOrdering: State lighting/exposure replaces clear fixture; surface shading => one integrated fog optical depth in linear light => shared exposure/tone-map. Never stack additional distance fades. Overhead stratus is not shallow street fog.
